items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Paquito is the little for Francisco in Latin America. ... My father’s name was Francisco also

ctx.x: Paquito is the little for Francisco in Latin America. Tito, or Paquito Paco, it is a little word for Francisco. My father’s name was Francisco also, but, his little one was Tito, like Tito Puente.
And what is your date of birth?
